candidates.snippet: 1754: Education at Collège Mazarin - Lavoisier studied at the Collège Mazarin, receiving a well-rounded education in science and law. 1774: Published 'Mémoires de Physique et de Chimie' - Lavoisier published his seminal work, laying the groundwork for modern chemistry and introducing the law of conservation of mass. 1777: Appointed Fermier Général - Lavoisier became a tax collector for the French monarchy, a role that provided him with financial resources for his research. 1794: Executed during the French Revolution - Lavoisier was guillotined during the Reign of Terror, a tragic end to a brilliant scientific career.
